english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for agreeing with an opinion or approving a proposal.

english.meaning: agree, be of the same opinion
english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for agreeing with someone's opinion or statement.

examples.english: I agree with what you said.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ji3 nei5 ge3 gong2 faat3

examples.english: I concur with what you said; this approach is the safest.
examples.traditional: 我同意你講，呢個做法最穩陣。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ji3 nei5 gong2 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 zeoi3 wan2 zan6
